column1: # Known faults of history_check.py on the saves of run-logs/release-test-0.6.0 (0.6.0, 30 October 2026).

# Columns rules and accepted (optional): rules "on" or "off" limits the row to a game with that changing-rules setting.
# The year of a row may be a range A-B (for example 2003-2010): it covers a fault of those years in a save of those years.
# accepted "design" or "real" marks a row whose note cites a source (an address of the original, a rules row, a web page)
# that shows the game matches the original or real life: it is no fault for Q12 and the run set counts it apart.
